facts: Status: DEPLOYED in environment Vercel Hobby + personal macOS server
Public surface: Next.js (Astra chat and website routes run from the Vercel deployment.)
Gateway runtime: Python 3.14 (FastAPI service managed with uv and typed Python services.)
Model contract: OpenAI /v1 (Chat, completions, embeddings, responses, image, and model routes.)
Private stores: PG/Redis/Qdrant (PostgreSQL is live for keys and usage; Redis/Qdrant are staged.)
Zone Vercel Hobby Serverless: Public website, Astra UI, and Next.js API route boundary.
Zone Cloudflare Secure Edge: DNS, tunnel ingress, WAF rules, and zero-open-port routing.
Zone Personal macOS Server: FastAPI gateway on 127.0.0.1:8000 with Python orchestration.
Zone Private Local Services: Ollama, PostgreSQL 17, Redis 8, and Qdrant stay off the public internet.
Component Astra chat surface: Next.js UI and /api/chat route in JS/TS (Website-side agent experience runs in the Manoj site deployment and prepares OpenAI-compatible requests.)
Component TS agent layer: LangChain/deepagents tooling with gateway baseURL (Uses MANOJ_LLM_BASE_URL and MANOJ_LLM_API_KEY to call the OpenAI-compatible gateway contract.)
Component Cloudflare Tunnel: api.manojmukherjee.co.in to local gateway (Public HTTPS traffic reaches the private gateway without opening inbound ports on the Mac.)
Component FastAPI gateway: Python 3.14, uv, OpenAI-compatible routes (Exposes /v1/chat/completions, /v1/models, /v1/responses, /api/v1/agent/direct-message, and admin key routes.)
Component Auth and usage: SHA-256 API keys with PostgreSQL usage logs (Validates X-API-Key or bearer tokens, marks last-used timestamps, and records endpoint/model usage.)
Component Python LangGraph: StateGraph astream with custom SSE chunks (DirectMessageAgentService compiles a Python StateGraph and streams custom chunks from the internal OpenAI service.)
Component Ollama client: AsyncOpenAI wrapper over local Ollama /v1 (The gateway forwards compatible payloads to Ollama, defaulting to llama3.2 when a model is not supplied.)
Component Private data plane: PostgreSQL 17, Redis 8, Qdrant clients (PostgreSQL is used for key records and usage logs; Redis and Qdrant are wired for future cache and RAG paths.)
